## bijection_verdict

**KB-BIJECTION RED** — KB-01 only.
- KB-01 `docs/cpi/feed_state_expiry_buffer_6bb4fe3b.json`, sentence after the table: "For a contract of any other state this schedule sets no expiry buffer." Source ladder `feed_buffer_days` otherwise → `P('min_days_to_expiration_at_verification')` = 15 calendar days. The factor document does not carry the value of this tier (neither the figure nor the product figure's name), and its words admit the reading "no buffer (0 days)", under which a proof of a non-listed state expiring 1–14 days after the reach date would pass. Untriggered in this task (TX), recorded under the whole-domain rule. (Same defect in the fax sibling, see task 1.)
- First revision for this difficulty; no older revision.

## dependency_form

- Prerequisite sentences: verbatim in the root hub only, state form, under the heading "Conditions on the refund"; no same-form restatement elsewhere; depended-on hubs do not carry them.
- No other problem's tool name in any document; no route, checklist, dependency table or chain; no example walks across problems; no wrong-vs-right contrast between problems.
- Titles: general subjects ("Re-Review of Insurer-Feed Proof of Insurance on a Closed Tracking Record", "Closing-Month Refund Check after Payoff of a Force-Placed Contract" = the on_request request type).
- Depended-on documents findable from the sentence's own words ("re-review", "insurer-feed proof", "uploaded binder") and the record words (`verification_source`, rejection result).
- Computation documents carry no "unless/adjustments/certain customers" hint; factor documents name no other factor and do not point at the calculation document.
- Hub sentences naming sibling rules ("fixed by the closing-month refund rule ... and by the closing-period refund rule"; "a rejected uploaded binder and a rejected faxed proof ... each by the re-review rule written for it") and the depended-on rules' "re-reviewed solely to fix the premium refunds owed on the record" are the source's own replaced_by text — policy-side note P-1, not a KB verdict.
- **PASS** (KB-EXPLICIT).

## notes (non-defects)

- N-1: ceiling stacking ("plus every allowance this rule states") is not written as one sentence; it is entailed by each allowance doc's "is raised by" (both tasks sit exactly on the stacked boundaries and the blind audit reached them).
- N-2: book-value allowance docs contrast the contract book value with the plan-band valuation — an evidence-field disambiguation, not a described mistake or tier hint.
- N-3: the replacement-day term of the source baseline (all allowances 0) is carried only in the grace factor docs; the calculation doc's assembly (covered + post-closing) is identical at every default, and restating it would signal the graces.
- N-4: fall-through tiers "no such substitution of the reach date applies" / "no change under this rule" cannot be read as a different value (contrast KB-01).
- P-1 (policy side): the depended-on re-review rules' own replaced_by states their purpose ("solely to fix the premium refunds owed on the record"), which tells a reader the re-review feeds refunds; source wording, rendered faithfully.
